SELECT followTrading.*, tutorInfo.tutor_name AS tutorName, userInfo.level_id AS levelId, levelDef.level_val, levelDef.level_name, signInfo.item_type, signInfo.sign_type, signInfo.stock_name, signInfo.stock_code, signInfo.stock_type FROM user_follow_up_trading followTrading LEFT JOIN tutor_info tutorInfo ON followTrading.tutor_id = tutorInfo.id LEFT JOIN user_info userInfo ON followTrading.user_id = userInfo.id LEFT JOIN sign_info signInfo ON followTrading.sign_id = signInfo.id LEFT JOIN level_def levelDef ON userInfo.level_id = levelDef.id
followTrading.id = #{param.id} and
followTrading.user_id = #{param.userId} and
followTrading.position_id = #{param.positionId} and
followTrading.follow_record_id = #{param.followRecordId} and
followTrading.trading_order_sn = #{param.tradingOrderSn} and
followTrading.tutor_id = #{param.tutorId} and
tutorInfo.domain_type = #{param.domainType} and
signInfo.item_type = #{param.itemType} and
signInfo.sign_type = #{param.signType} and
signInfo.stock_name = #{param.stockName} and
signInfo.stock_code = #{param.stockCode} and
followTrading.trading_time >= #{param.tradingTimeStart} and
followTrading.trading_time <= #{param.tradingTimeEnd} and
followTrading.operator = #{param.operator} and
(signInfo.stock_code like '%${param.stockCodeOrName}%' or signInfo.stock_name like '%${param.stockCodeOrName}%') and
ORDER BY followTrading.trading_time DESC
